title: Facebook Registration Assistant Update v1.1.2
description:
• 🌐 Proxy-Bypass & WinError 10061 Fix: Automatic direct-connection fallback for updates and Apify live UID verification.
• ⚡ Direct Background OTP Polling: Zero browser tabs opened for OTP, preventing window resize and flicker.
• 🪟 Locked 640x510 Window Sizing: Chromium strictly forced to normal 640x510 bounds with CDP lock.
• 🛡️ Strict OTP Verification: 'otp not received' error with zero UID disclosure until OTP is confirmed submitted.
